# Shiftup Lab Private Limited
> Building the intelligence layer for the world's student ecosystem.
> https://shiftuplab.com

## Company
- Name: Shiftup Lab Private Limited
- Location: Bengaluru, India
- Scope: India → Asia → Global
- Stage: Idea / MVP, pre-traction
- Raise: ₹5 Cr pre-seed (currently raising)

## Flagship Product: Dino
- Category: The Non-Academic Student Ecosystem
- Tagline: Your Student Digital Twin. Your AI BFF. Your Student World.
- Promise: Think. Plan. Execute. Decide.
- Journey: Identity → Interests → People → Community → Decisions → Opportunities → Skills → Career → Life

## Student Digital Twin
A student-owned, privacy-conscious model of evolving interests, goals, preferences, skills, and decisions powering contextual intelligence in Dino.

## Jenny AI
Context-aware AI companion inside Dino for planning and decisions — not generic chat; not a replacement for professional counselling.

## Vision
A world where no student navigates the future alone.

## Mission
Give every student an intelligent, trusted, human-centred ecosystem for thinking, planning, executing, and deciding.

## Ethics (summary)
Student first; no selling personal data; no manipulation; transparent sponsorship; no fake reviews; privacy and safety by design; student autonomy; explainable AI.

## Business model (planned)
Student subscriptions; premium AI; marketplace commissions; events; institutional SaaS; brand partnerships; long-term intelligence APIs and services.
